environment.description: Flask application deployed on EC2 instance behind an Application Load Balancer. The application runs as a systemd service under a non-root user 'appuser'. The /tmp/processing directory is on a shared tmpfs mount. Multiple worker processes run concurrently (gunicorn with 4 workers). The ALB forwards all traffic from the public internet on port 443 to the instance on port 8080. No request authentication is configured at the ALB or application level. The instance security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0.
